facts.statement: Ganzhousaurus fossils were discovered in a Maastrichtian deposit.
facts.quote: It was found in a Maastrichtian deposit

facts.statement: The dinosaur lived during the Late Cretaceous in the Nanxiong Formation of Nankang County in southern China.
facts.quote: known from the Late Cretaceous Nanxiong Formation of Nankang County, Ganzhou City of Jiangxi Province, southern China

facts.statement: The genus Ganzhousaurus contains only one known species, Ganzhousaurus nankangensis.
facts.quote: contains a single species, Ganzhousaurus nankangensis

facts.statement: Ganzhousaurus is characterized by a mix of primitive and derived anatomical features.
facts.quote: It is distinguished by a combination of primitive and derived features

facts.statement: Scientific analysis classifies Ganzhousaurus as a member of the family Oviraptoridae.
facts.quote: Phylogenetic analysis places Ganzhousaurus within Oviraptoridae

facts.statement: There is debate regarding Ganzhousaurus's exact position within Oviraptoridae, with some studies placing it in Oviraptorinae and others linking it closely to Ingeniinae.
facts.quote: one phylogenetic analysis recovering it as a member of the Oviraptorinae and another recovering it as a more derived member of the group, closely related to "ingeniines"

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that Ganzhousaurus was primarily herbivorous.
Ganzhousaurus lived alongside at least four other oviraptorid species in the same habitat.
facts.quote: Ganzhousaurus shared its habitat with at least four other oviraptorid species

facts.statement: Ganzhousaurus belongs to the dinosaur family Oviraptoridae.
Ganzhousaurus lived approximately 70 to 66 million years ago during the late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: que vivió en el año finales del período Cretácico hace aproximadamente entre 70 y 66 millones de años

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis places Ganzhousaurus within the family Oviraptoridae.
facts.quote: El análisis filogenético coloca a Ganzhousaurus dentro de Oviraptoridae

facts.statement: Studies disagree on whether Ganzhousaurus is a member of Oviraptorinae or a more derived group related to Ingeniinae.
facts.quote: con un estudio recuperándolo como miembro de Oviraptorinae y otro recuperándolo como un miembro más derivado del grupo, estrechamente relacionado con Ingeniinae

facts.statement: Ganzhousaurus is considered to have been primarily herbivorous.
Ganzhousaurus lived between 72.2 and 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group for Ganzhousaurus is identified as Heyuanninae.
